testCases.summary: Add retry logic with exponential backoff for 5XX server errors in BaseApiClient for API Automation

scenarios.title: Successful API call on first attempt without retry
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with retry logic enabled
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3
And exponential backoff strategy is enabled
And API endpoint is available and responding normally

steps.action: When client makes API request to endpoint
steps.expectedResult: Request is sent to server successfully

steps.action: When server responds with 200 OK status
steps.expectedResult: Response is received with valid data

steps.action: Then client returns response without retry attempts
steps.expectedResult: No retry logic is triggered, response returned immediately

steps.action: Then logs show single successful request with no retry entries
steps.expectedResult: Log contains one request entry with 200 status, zero retry attempts

scenarios.expectedResult: API call succeeds on first attempt without triggering retry mechanism, logs confirm single successful request
scenarios.automationHint: Mock API response with 200 status; verify retry counter remains 0; assert log contains single entry; Example: when(mockClient.execute(request)).thenReturn(response200); verify(mockClient, times(1)).execute(any());

scenarios.title: Retry logic triggers on 500 Internal Server Error and succeeds on second attempt
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with retry logic enabled
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3
And exponential backoff is enabled with initial delay of 1 second
And logging is configured to capture retry attempts

steps.action: When client makes API request to endpoint
steps.expectedResult: First request is sent to server

steps.action: When server responds with 500 Internal Server Error
steps.expectedResult: Client detects 5XX error and initiates retry logic

steps.action: When client waits for exponential backoff delay and retries
steps.expectedResult: Second request is sent after calculated delay

steps.action: When server responds with 200 OK on second attempt
steps.expectedResult: Client receives successful response and stops retrying

steps.action: Then logs show initial 500 error and successful retry with attempt number
steps.expectedResult: Log contains: Attempt 1 failed with 500, Attempt 2 succeeded with 200

scenarios.expectedResult: API call fails initially with 500 error, retry logic triggers with exponential backoff, second attempt succeeds, detailed logs capture both attempts
scenarios.automationHint: Mock sequence: first call returns 500, second returns 200; verify execute() called twice; assert backoff delay occurred; Example: when(mockClient.execute(request)).thenReturn(response500, response200); verify exponential delay calculation;

scenarios.title: Retry logic exhausts maximum attempts on persistent 503 Service Unavailable
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with retry logic enabled
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3
And exponential backoff is enabled
And server is persistently unavailable

steps.action: When client makes API request to endpoint
steps.expectedResult: First request is sent to server

steps.action: When server responds with 503 Service Unavailable on all attempts
steps.expectedResult: Client retries 3 times with exponential backoff delays

steps.action: When maximum retry limit is reached
steps.expectedResult: Client stops retrying and throws appropriate exception

steps.action: Then logs show all 4 attempts (initial + 3 retries) with 503 status
steps.expectedResult: Log contains: Attempt 1-4 all failed with 503, max retries exceeded

steps.action: Then exception message indicates retry exhaustion with final status code
steps.expectedResult: Exception message: 'Max retries (3) exceeded for 503 Service Unavailable'

scenarios.expectedResult: API call fails persistently, retry logic attempts maximum 3 retries with exponential backoff, final exception thrown with clear message, all attempts logged
scenarios.automationHint: Mock all responses with 503; verify execute() called 4 times total (1 initial + 3 retries); assert exception type and message; Example: when(mockClient.execute(request)).thenReturn(response503); verify(mockClient, times(4)).execute(any()); assertThrows(MaxRetriesExceededException.class);

scenarios.title: Retry logic does not trigger for 4XX client errors
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with retry logic enabled
And retry logic is configured only for 5XX errors
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3

steps.action: When client makes API request with invalid authentication
steps.expectedResult: Request is sent to server

steps.action: When server responds with 401 Unauthorized
steps.expectedResult: Client receives 401 status code

steps.action: Then client does not trigger retry logic
steps.expectedResult: No retry attempts are made

steps.action: Then exception is thrown immediately with 401 status
steps.expectedResult: Client throws exception without delay

steps.action: Then logs show single failed request with no retry entries
steps.expectedResult: Log contains: Attempt 1 failed with 401, no retry attempts

scenarios.expectedResult: 4XX client errors do not trigger retry mechanism, immediate failure with appropriate exception, logs confirm no retry attempts
scenarios.automationHint: Mock response with 401 status; verify execute() called only once; assert no delay occurred; Example: when(mockClient.execute(request)).thenReturn(response401); verify(mockClient, times(1)).execute(any()); verify no Thread.sleep() calls;

scenarios.title: Exponential backoff delays increase correctly between retry attempts
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with exponential backoff enabled
And initial backoff delay is 1 second
And backoff multiplier is 2
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3

steps.action: When client makes API request and receives 502 Bad Gateway
steps.expectedResult: First retry is scheduled after 1 second delay

steps.action: When first retry fails with 502 Bad Gateway
steps.expectedResult: Second retry is scheduled after 2 second delay (1 * 2^1)

steps.action: When second retry fails with 502 Bad Gateway
steps.expectedResult: Third retry is scheduled after 4 second delay (1 * 2^2)

steps.action: Then logs show increasing delay times between attempts
steps.expectedResult: Log shows: Retry 1 after 1s, Retry 2 after 2s, Retry 3 after 4s

scenarios.expectedResult: Exponential backoff delays increase correctly (1s, 2s, 4s) between retry attempts, preventing server overload during recovery
scenarios.automationHint: Capture timestamps between retry attempts; calculate actual delays; assert delays match exponential pattern; Example: long[] delays = captureDelays(); assertEquals(1000, delays[0], 100); assertEquals(2000, delays[1], 100); assertEquals(4000, delays[2], 100);

scenarios.title: Retry logic handles all 5XX status codes (500, 502, 503, 504)
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with retry logic for all 5XX errors
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3
And exponential backoff is enabled

steps.action: When client encounters 500 Internal Server Error
steps.expectedResult: Retry logic is triggered

steps.action: When client encounters 502 Bad Gateway
steps.expectedResult: Retry logic is triggered

steps.action: When client encounters 503 Service Unavailable
steps.expectedResult: Retry logic is triggered

steps.action: When client encounters 504 Gateway Timeout
steps.expectedResult: Retry logic is triggered

steps.action: Then logs confirm retry attempts for each 5XX status code
steps.expectedResult: All 5XX errors trigger retry mechanism consistently

scenarios.expectedResult: Retry logic correctly identifies and handles all 5XX status codes (500, 502, 503, 504) with consistent retry behavior
scenarios.automationHint: Test each 5XX status code separately; verify retry triggered for each; Example: testRetryFor500(); testRetryFor502(); testRetryFor503(); testRetryFor504(); assert retry count > 0 for all;

scenarios.title: Retry logic with zero maximum retries configured
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 0
And retry logic is enabled

steps.action: When client makes API request to endpoint
steps.expectedResult: Request is sent to server

steps.action: When server responds with 500 Internal Server Error
steps.expectedResult: Client receives 500 status code

steps.action: Then client does not attempt any retries
steps.expectedResult: Exception is thrown immediately without retry

steps.action: Then logs show single failed request with zero retry attempts
steps.expectedResult: Log contains: Attempt 1 failed with 500, max retries set to 0

scenarios.expectedResult: When max retries is 0, no retry attempts are made even for 5XX errors, immediate failure occurs
scenarios.automationHint: Configure maxRetries=0; mock 500 response; verify execute() called once; assert no delays; Example: client.setMaxRetries(0); verify(mockClient, times(1)).execute(any());

scenarios.title: Concurrent API calls each maintain independent retry state
preconditions: Given BaseApiClient is initialized with retry logic enabled
And maximum retry attempts is configured to 3
And multiple concurrent API calls are in progress

steps.action: When client makes 5 concurrent API requests
steps.expectedResult: All 5 requests are sent simultaneously

steps.action: When 3 requests fail with 503 and 2 succeed with 200
steps.expectedResult: Failed requests trigger independent retry logic

steps.action: When retry attempts succeed at different times
steps.expectedResult: Each request maintains its own retry counter and state

steps.action: Then logs show separate retry sequences for each failed request
steps.expectedResult: Logs clearly distinguish between concurrent request retry attempts

scenarios.expectedResult: Concurrent API calls maintain independent retry state without interference, each request tracks its own retry count and backoff timing
scenarios.automationHint: Use ExecutorService for concurrent requests; verify thread-safety; assert each request has independent retry counter; Example: ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(5); verify retry state isolation;
